The clinic's original name was Surat Dental Clinic. The doctor there is excellent. I personally had problems with crowded teeth, incisors, and protruding teeth. Before treatment, I consulted with 2-3 clinics, but the doctors there recommended Dr. Surat.

In my case, when I was a child, the doctor at the hospital recommended waiting for the bone to stop growing and then undergoing jaw surgery to fix it with screws. However, nowadays, orthodontic treatment can be started from a young age, using jaw expansion devices to accommodate bone growth as I grow – that's what the doctor explained.

For treatment, the doctor used a simplified plate to aid chewing during orthodontic treatment instead of surgery, which was very reassuring. Thank you so much, Dr. Surat!

My first time at this dental clinic was a great experience! The dentist was very gentle and kind, which significantly reduced my fear. The clinic is easy to find using Google Maps.
There's street parking in front of the clinic and across the street. The clinic is clean.
The air conditioning is refreshingly cool, and there's free Wi-Fi.
There's a clean restroom at the back, and an X-ray machine inside.
If you're interested in braces, dentures, extractions, fillings, or teeth cleaning, I highly recommend this place!
